gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One reads big-eyed and uniform, like laser-cut sheet. Metamorphous up top carries a light modulation you notice only on close inspection, so text below rolls on smoothly, with little to snag the eye.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One spaces its sizable lowercase widely and draws a ballpoint line, while Metamorphous leads. Reading it feels easygoing and unhurried, each word given room to stand.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-montserrat-underl: Neon-tube lines and big lowercase: Montserrat Underline keeps constant thickness, set against Metamorphous with its thin strokes close to thick. Long reading stays smooth and unfussy, with breathing counters.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-adlam-u: Metamorphous sets its midline high and leaves generous sidebearings, while Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined stays low in contrast. One feels commanding, the other quietly modern, and they sit together comfortably.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-balines: Metamorphous leads with a high midline and soft stroke shifts. Noto Sans Balinese, a sans-serif with short ascenders, stays low in contrast, leaving Metamorphous to earn its keep in big, short lines.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-bassa-v: Metamorphous sets a high midline and a faint pinch where curves meet straight stems. And Noto Sans Bassa Vah, a sans-serif with a dominant midsection, supplies the plainness that lets that character carry.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-batak: Metamorphous carries a high midline and modulation you spot only up close. Noto Sans Batak, a plain sans with a towering x-height, plus an unsqueezed e, takes over the page without competing.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali speaks plainly, its capitals barely taller than lowercase and its letter mouths distinctly open. Metamorphous above it supplies the commanding, distinctive voice, with in-between stroke contrast.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-carian: Noto Sans Carian reads cleanly, its terminals held apart like scissor blades. And across many lines of text it stays tidy and quiet, while Metamorphous owns the moderate stroke contrast.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-cheroke: Metamorphous carries a high-set midline and in-between stroke contrast, which gives it a commanding, distinctive presence. Noto Sans Cherokee, a plain sans, does the quiet and steady reading work.
